_comment: Reviewed exceptions for links that cannot be automatically checked.

bay-area-running-club.note: Site has intermittent TLS errors but loads correctly. Manually verified - official BARC site with club info, history, and Space City 10 Miler details.

black-men-run-houston.note: Site returns 403 due to bot protection (Cloudflare) but is the official chapter page. Manually verified via web search - contains group info and Facebook group link.

atascocita-titans-track-club.note: Instagram page - rate limited by platform. No official website found. Club is active on social media. Manually verified existence.

citycentre-running-club.note: Facebook page - may get rate limited. FFP affiliate club meets at CityCentre. No dedicated website. Manually verified page exists.

west-end-running-club.note: Facebook page - may get rate limited. FFP affiliate club on Washington Ave. No dedicated website. Manually verified page exists.

westchase-district-run-club.note: Facebook page - may get rate limited. FFP affiliate club in Westchase. No dedicated website. Manually verified page exists.

northwest-flyers-track-club.note: Site has TLS certificate verification issues but is legitimate. Track club in Tomball/NW Houston. Manually verified site loads and contains club information.

runners-high-club.note: Site has TLS certificate verification issues but is legitimate. Marathon/half training program at Memorial Park since 1997. Manually verified site loads and contains club information.

the-gooses-acre-run-club.note: Site returns 403 due to bot protection but is the official pub/club page. The Goose's Acre is a pub in The Woodlands that hosts the running club. Manually verified via web search.

holler-haulers-run-club.note: Brewery website - club section may not use exact club name in every heading. Holler Brewing hosts the Holler Haulers run club. Wednesday night runs. Manually verified.

njord-running.note: Combined run crew + apparel brand. Site uses Njörd (with special char) and focuses on apparel, but About and Weekly Run Crew pages confirm it's a Houston run crew. Manually verified.

texas-trackstars.note: Track club site - full team name may vary. Long-established track club (30+ years). Manually verified site loads and contains club info.

tornados-running-club.note: Club site - normalized name match fails due to common word stripping. Site clearly identifies as Tornados Running Club across multiple pages. 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded 1988. Manually verified.

the-woodlands-running-club.note: Site can be slow to respond but loads correctly. Very active large nonprofit club in The Woodlands with track workouts, long runs, trail running, and Juniors program. Manually verified.

samuel-aramco-half-course-record-2026.note: Houston Chronicle article - paywall/subscriber content may limit bot access. Article about Habtom Samuel's course record at Aramco Houston Half. Manually verified URL format and article exists.

houston-marathon-2026-road-closures.note: Houston Chronicle article - paywall/subscriber content may limit bot access. Pre-event guide for 2026 Houston Marathon road closures. Manually verified URL format and article exists.
